name: Why is professional drain cleaning better than chemical drain cleaners?

mainEntity.name: Why is professional drain cleaning better than chemical drain cleaners?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional drain cleaning methods, such as snaking or hydro-jetting, physically remove the clog without introducing harsh chemicals into your plumbing system. Chemical drain cleaners can be corrosive, potentially damaging pipes over time, especially older ones, and are often ineffective against severe clogs. Professional services offer a safer, more effective, and longer-lasting solution, protecting your plumbing investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional drain cleaning physically removes clogs without harsh chemicals that can damage pipes, offering a safer and more effective solution.
